business_summary: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. manufactures and sells belts and construction materials in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automobile and motorcycle transmission belts and related products, such as timing belts, variable speed belts, v-ribbed belts, raw edge v-belts, worm wheels, and accessory drive systems; and industrial power transmission belts and related products, including v-belts for general industry and agricultural machinery, timing belts for general industry, RIBSTAR belts, polyurethane belts, FLEXSTAR belts, pulleys, and couplings. It also provides conveyer belts, systems, and related products comprising mamaline, LOGISTAR, and tailormade solutions; and engineering plastic materials and processed products, such as molecular weight and density polyethylene, cast-nylon, clean-PE products, polyacetal, polyetheretherketone, polyphenylenesulfide, and polytetrafluoroethylene. In addition, the company offers waterproofing materials for construction and related products; civil engineering water-shielding materials; electronic and coating materials consisting of conductive, metal, glass, pastes, and resistive pastes; copper sintering paste, cushioning materials, thick film solutions, metallized ceramic substrates, via-filling solutions, and decorative paints; and star wipers. It serves to automobile, two-wheelers, agriculture/forestry, industrial machinery, robot, money handling machine, logistics/transportation, construction/civil engineering, semiconductor/battery, food, medical/health, life, amusement, energy, printer, environment, and society applications. The company was formerly known as Mitsuboshi Chotai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. in May 1961. Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
